arxiv-2103-10612.title: LINEAR RELATIONS AMONG GALOIS CONJUGATES OVER 𝔽 q ​ ( t ) \mathbb{F}_{q}(t)
arxiv-2103-10612.creator: Will Hardt and John Yin
arxiv-2103-10612.description: Abstract 1. Abstract We classify the coefficients (a_{1},...,a_{n})\in\mathbb{F}_{q}[t]^{n} that can appear in a linear relation \sum_{i=1}^{n}a_{i}\gamma_{i}=0 among Galois conjugates \gamma_{i}\in\overline{\mathbb{F}_{q}(t)} . We call such an n -tuple a Smyth tuple . Our main theorem gives an affirmative answer to a function field analogue of a 1986 conjecture of Smyth [ 4 ] over \mathbb{Q} .

arxiv-2110-08107.title: A micromagnetic theory of skyrmion lifetime in ultrathin ferromagnetic films
arxiv-2110-08107.creator: Anne Bernand-Mantel, Cyrill B. Muratov, Valeriy V. Slastikov
arxiv-2110-08107.description: Abstract We use the continuum micromagnetic framework to derive the formulas for compact skyrmion lifetime due to thermal noise in ultrathin ferromagnetic films with relatively weak interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction. In the absence of a saddle point connecting the skyrmion solution to the ferromagnetic state, we interpret the skyrmion collapse event as “capture by an absorber” at microscale.

arxiv-2211-02734.title: Close Encounters of Tight Binary Stars with Stellar-mass Black Holes 2022 Close Encounters of Tight Binary Stars with Stellar-mass Black Holes –
arxiv-2211-02734.creator: Taeho Ryu, Rosalba Perna, Ruediger Pakmor, Jing-Ze Ma, Rob Farmer, Selma E. de Mink
arxiv-2211-02734.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Taeho Ryu, Rosalba Perna, Ruediger Pakmor, Jing-Ze Ma, Rob Farmer, Selma E. de Mink. Strong dynamical interactions among stars and compact objects are expected in a variety of astrophysical settings, such as star clusters and the disks of active galactic nuclei.

arxiv-2310-13826.title: A p p -value for process tracing and other N = 1 N=1 studies
arxiv-2310-13826.creator: Matias López, Jake Bowers
arxiv-2310-13826.description: Abstract We introduce a method for calculating p p -values when testing causal theories about a single case, for instance when conducting process tracing. As in Fisher’s (1935) original design, our p p -value indicates how frequently one would find the same or more favorable evidence while entertaining a rival theory (the null) for the sake of argument.

arxiv-2407-13098.title: Optimal Tree Tensor Network Operators for Tensor Network Simulations: Applications to Open Quantum Systems
arxiv-2407-13098.creator: Weitang Li, Jiajun Ren, Hengrui Yang, Haobin Wang, Zhigang Shuai
arxiv-2407-13098.description: Abstract Tree tensor network states (TTNS) decompose the system wavefunction to the product of low-rank tensors based on the tree topology, serving as the foundation of the multi-layer multi-configuration time-dependent Hartree (ML-MCTDH) method. In this work, we present an algorithm that automatically constructs the optimal and exact tree tensor network operators (TTNO) for any sum-of-product symbolic quantum operator.

arxiv-2409-11645.title: The Effects of Generative AI Agents and Scaffolding on Enhancing Students’ Comprehension of Visual Learning Analytics
arxiv-2409-11645.creator: Lixiang Yan, Roberto Martinez-Maldonado, Yueqiao Jin, Vanessa Echeverria, Mikaela Milesi, Jie Fan, Linxuan Zhao, Riordan Alfredo, Xinyu Li, Dragan Gašević
arxiv-2409-11645.description: Abstract Visual learning analytics (VLA) is becoming increasingly adopted in educational technologies and learning analytics dashboards to convey critical insights to students and educators. Yet many students experienced difficulties in comprehending complex VLA due to their limited data visualisation literacy.

arxiv-2411-07744.title: Characterising high and low accretion states in VY Scl CVs using ZTF and TESS data
arxiv-2411-07744.creator: C. Duffy, Kinwah Wu, G. Ramsay, Matt A. Wood, Paul A. Mason, Pasi Hakala, D. Steeghs
arxiv-2411-07744.description: Abstract VY Scl binaries are a sub-class of cataclysmic variable (CV) which show extended low states, but do not show outbursts which are seen in other classes of CV. To better determine how often these systems spend in low states and to resolve the state transitions we have analysed ZTF data on eight systems and TESS data on six systems.

arxiv-2502-01534.title: Preference Leakage : A Contamination Problem in LLM-as-a-judge
arxiv-2502-01534.creator: Dawei Li, Renliang Sun, Yue Huang, Ming Zhong, Bohan Jiang, Jiawei Han, Xiangliang Zhang, Wei Wang, Huan Liu
arxiv-2502-01534.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) as judges and LLM-based data synthesis have emerged as two fundamental LLM-driven data annotation methods in model development. While their combination significantly enhances the efficiency of model training and evaluation, little attention has been given to the potential contamination brought by this new model development paradigm.

arxiv-2502-20126.title: FlexiDiT: Your Diffusion Transformer Can Easily Generate High-Quality Samples with Less Compute
arxiv-2502-20126.creator: Sotiris Anagnostidis, Gregor Bachmann, Yeongmin Kim, Jonas Kohler, Markos Georgopoulos, Artsiom Sanakoyeu, Yuming Du, Albert Pumarola, Ali Thabet, Edgar Schönfeld
arxiv-2502-20126.description: Abstract Despite their remarkable performance, modern Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) are hindered by substantial resource requirements during inference, stemming from the fixed and large amount of compute needed for each denoising step. In this work, we revisit the conventional static paradigm that allocates a fixed compute budget per denoising iteration and propose a dynamic strategy instead.

pmc-11566882.title: Prevalence and local transmission of haemosporidian (Haemosporida) parasites in nestlings of birds of prey (Aves, Accipitriformes) in the temperate forests in Lithuania
pmc-11566882.creator: Dovilė Bukauskaitė, Carolina Romeiro Fernandes Chagas, Mélanie Duc, Margarita Kazak, Rimgaudas Treinys
pmc-11566882.description: Wild birds of prey (Accipitriformes) are infected with haemosporidian (Haemosporida) parasites worldwide, and it is known that these parasites can negatively affect their health. These birds are less studied due to their low densities in ecosystems, conservation status, and difficulty of accessing them in the wild.

pmc-12426910.title: Objective Assessment of Physical Activity in Breast Cancer Survivors: Associations With Adiposity and Metabolic Parameters of Glucose and Insulin—Insights From NHANES
pmc-12426910.creator: Jose J Cao‐Alvira, Emilia F Luciano, Moira Sauane, Columba de la Parra
pmc-12426910.description: BackgroundPhysical activity (PA) is a modifiable lifestyle factor strongly linked to adiposity and metabolic health. Breast cancer survivors are at a higher risk of obesity‐related metabolic complications, negatively impacting prognosis and quality of life. Therefore, updated objective assessments of PA and its effects on metabolic health are critical to improving survivorship care.

pmc-12429876.title: Analysis of Coupled Response Characteristics of NAI Release and Stem Flow in Four Urban Greening Tree Species in Beijing During Drought Stress and Recovery Processes
pmc-12429876.creator: Xueqiang Liu, Bin Li, Weikang Zhang, Shaowei Lu, Jigui Wu, Jing An, Yaqian Fan, Na Zhao, Xiaotian Xu, Shaoning Li, Janusz J Zwiazek
pmc-12429876.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Negative air ions (NAI) represent an important ecological value indicator for green tree species. Flow of sap is a crucial indicator for water utilization and physiological state of trees. Although there have been some advancements in studies on the correlation between the release of NAI by plants and sap flow in recent years, it is still unclear how the release of NAI by plants changes during drought stress and recovery processes, as well as the coupling effect between the release of NAI

pmc-12796880.title: Cardio-Cerebral Protective Effect of Moxibustion on Phlegm-Dampness Type Hypertension: Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-12796880.creator: Ling Cheng, Ning Bai, Liang Zheng, Lulu Cao, Huangan Wu, Ruiping Wang, Chen Zhao, Yunli Shen, Haiyin Zhao, Gang Li, Bing Yang, Qinghui Yang, Yan Xing, Jianhong Cao, Yixing Wang, Ling Xu, Junjie Yan, Jie Cao, Yiyang Guo
pmc-12796880.description: BackgroundHypertension is associated with a high rate of disability and mortality and leads to a substantial socioeconomic burden. Moxibustion is an external treatment in traditional Chinese medicine that has been used to treat mild to moderate hypertension in individuals with phlegm-dampness constitution and has demonstrated acupoint specificity.

pmc-12824264.title: Endoglin as a BMP9 Co-Receptor in Vascular Endothelial Cells: Prodomain Displacement and TGFBRII Recruitment
pmc-12824264.creator: Jingxu Guo, Karolina Kostrzyńska, Ioannis Kamzolas, Xudong Yang, Midory Thorikay, Eckart De Bie, Rowena J. Jones, Adam Brownstein, Lu Long, Christopher J. Rhodes, Allan Lawrie, Martin R. Wilkins, Esmee Groeneveld, Zhen Tong, Marie-José Goumans, Evangelia Petsalaki, Jason Hong, Mark R. Toshner, Anton
pmc-12824264.description: Endoglin (ENG) is a single-pass transmembrane protein highly expressed in vascular endothelial cells (ECs), where it plays fundamental roles in EC functions. ENG is implicated in several cardiovascular disorders including hereditary haemorrhagic telangiectasia, pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) and preeclampsia. However, molecular mechanisms underlying ENG function are not fully understood.

pmc-13202843.title: Cost-utility analysis of sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors on chronic kidney disease progression in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus
pmc-13202843.creator: Sukanya Siriyotha, Amarit Tansawet, Oraluck Pattanaprateep, Tanawan Kongmalai, Panu Looareesuwan, Junwei Yang, Suparee W. Boonmanunt, Gareth J. McKay, John Attia, Ammarin Thakkinstian
pmc-13202843.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMany trials have highlighted the benefits of sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2is) in terms of chronic kidney disease (CKD) progression. However, SGLT2is are high-cost medication, and their cost- effectiveness varies by setting across countries.MethodsThis study aimed to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2is) in terms of chronic kidney disease (CKD) progression by utilizing data from the type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2D) cohort collected from 2010 to 2022 to estimate transitional probabilities and costs.

pmc-13223860.title: Cervical flexion–induced myelopathy (Hirayama disease): A radiology case report
pmc-13223860.creator: Balamurugan Ulaganathan, Arul Sakthi Priya Pandian, Eswaramoorthy Sellamuthu, Usha Jayagurunathan
pmc-13223860.description: Hirayama disease is a self-limiting cervical flexion myelopathy that typically affects adolescent and young adult males presenting with unilateral or asymmetric distal upper-limb weakness and atrophy. Early diagnosis is important because avoiding neck flexion with cervical collar immobilization may limit ongoing spinal cord injury and selected patients may require surgery.

pmc-13264128.title: Hyperspectral non-destructive detection based on geometrical influence correction and deep learning technology: A case study on early bruise detection in fruits
pmc-13264128.creator: Wei Tao, Yixiao Wang, Shan Zeng, Bing Li, Chaoxian Liu, Xiangjun Duan
pmc-13264128.description: Hyperspectral imaging is widely used for non-destructive detection in fruit because it can capture spectral differences arising from changes in tissue structure and chemical composition. However, variations in the curved-surface geometry of fruit often introduce non-structural spectral distortions. These distortions reduce detection accuracy and limit model generalisation.

pmc-13337970.title: Association Between Food Portions During Complementary Feeding and Later Overweight Risk: Analysis From European Childhood Obesity Project
pmc-13337970.creator: Irene Hernandez‐Perez, Joaquin Escribano, Veit Grote, Berthold Koletzko, Mariona Gispert‐Llauradó, Mireia Alcázar, Elvira Verduci, Dariusz Gruszfeld, Annick Xhonneux, Veronica Luque, H. Demmelmair, H. Demmelmair, U. Handel, I. Pawellek, S. Schiess, S. Verwied‐Jorky, M. Weber, R. Closa‐Monasterolo, M
pmc-13337970.description: Background and AimEarly‐life nutrition plays a critical role in long‐term health. Although complementary feeding has been widely studied, the influence of portion size during this stage on subsequent overweight risk remains unclear. This study aimed to evaluate whether portion size during complementary feeding is associated with overweight risk in childhood and preadolescence.

pmc-13460650.title: Spontaneous Achievers, Responders and Non‐Responders: Aligning Treatment With the Natural History of Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia in Preterm Infants
pmc-13460650.creator: Chad C. Andersen, Michael J. Stark
pmc-13460650.description: AimTo examine how early pulmonary phenotype influences treatment response and the interpretation of trial outcomes in bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD).MethodsA narrative review of early respiratory patterns in very preterm infants and their relationship to treatment response, using published trials of postnatal corticosteroids as the primary example.

pmc-13507777.title: Mechanical memory in cells: mechanisms, effects, and applications in regenerative medicine
pmc-13507777.creator: Antara Bhuyan, Mark Ahearne
pmc-13507777.description: Mechanical memory is the ability of cells to retain information from past mechanical environments, which profoundly influences cellular behaviour and fate, particularly in stem cells. This review combines contemporary insights into mechanical memory with specific attention to its underlying processes, which span mechanotransduction to epigenetic alterations.
